newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GAS FIRM TRANSPORTED 1.3 BLN CUBIC METRES.
newsitem.headline: GAS FIRM TRANSPORTED 1.3 BLN CUBIC METRES.

text.p: Lithuanian Gas said on Friday that it has imported 1.3 billion cubic metres of gas in the first five months of the year compared to 1.2 billion cubic metres in the same period in 1996.

"810 million cubic metres of it was acquired by Lithuanian Gas, 281 million cubic metres was transported to fertiliser producer Achema and the rest to smaller consumers," Martynas Bartys, the head of the commerce department, told Reuters.

Bartys said Lithuanian Gas bought 290 million cubic metres of gas directly from Russia's Gazprom and 485 million cubic metres from intermediary Russia-Lithuania joint venture Stella Vitae during the first five months of 1997.
He added that another 35 million cubic metres of gas was bought from an offshore company, Jamgela.
